text: What if tomorrow, the US dollar just... disappeared?
And all one hundred ninety-five countries had to share one single money?
Meet the Globo.
Cool. How much is a coffee?
Three Globos.
...Is that a lot?
Nobody knows. Not even the government.
Then someone checks the internet. A burger costs nine Globos in one country...
and two in another.
I'm flying there for lunch.
So are fifty million other people.
But here's the scary part. One money means one boss.
A single World Bank sets the rules... for eight billion people.
Raise interest rates!
Half the planet cheers.
The other half's economy catches fire.
Sounds crazy? Europe actually tried this.
Twenty countries share the euro... and when Greece crashed, it couldn't print its own money to escape.
But the biggest war? Whose face goes on the coin.
America wants an eagle.
France wants a croissant.
Canada politely suggests a moose.
Australia submits a spider the size of a dinner plate.
After four hundred hours of meetings... the winner is...
a potato.
Why a potato?!
It's the only thing every country already eats.
So be honest... would you keep the dollar, or switch to the potato coin?
